assumptions.assumption: The Supplier node is treated as a human external entity because the diagram identifies it as an actor rather than a named technical system.
assumptions.basis: The node is named "Supplier" and has an outgoing interaction to the supplier document portal, but no technical system is identified.

assumptions.assumption: The Landing bucket contains confidential data because it receives supplier data extracts derived from insurance certificates, food safety audits and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows the portal sending a "nightly supplier data extract (CSV)" to the Landing bucket, and the portal receives staff contact details and supplier documents.

assumptions.assumption: The Supplier database contains confidential data because it receives supplier records associated with the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The diagram shows the supplier master service sending "supplier records" to the Supplier database, with the service loading the supplier data extract.
